limits: Matching is on drug counts per level, not on training rows per level, because row counts follow drug frequency and cannot be matched simultaneously.
Retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim.

the_competing_explanation_is_excluded.the_worry: pathway levels differ enormously in size, and a bigger group has a better-estimated mean, so the prior could be a group-size effect with no biological content
the_competing_explanation_is_excluded.the_control: a random partition of the same drugs with the IDENTICAL multiset of group sizes, averaged over five draws per split
the_competing_explanation_is_excluded.reading: matching the sizes does not reproduce the gain: the size-matched partition adds +0.008 with an interval spanning zero, while the real partition adds +0.147. The content of the partition, not the size of its groups, carries the value.

this_strengthens_C108_rather_than_replac.C108_control: a random partition with the same NUMBER of groups
this_strengthens_C108_rather_than_replac.this_control: a random partition with the same SIZE MULTISET
this_strengthens_C108_rather_than_replac.why_this_one_is_stricter: it also matches how concentrated the groups are, so it cannot be beaten by the mechanism of 'big groups are better estimated'
this_strengthens_C108_rather_than_replac.both_controls_agree: equal-count random at minus 0.012 and size-matched random at plus 0.008, both indistinguishable from zero and both far below the real partition

a_note_on_the_level_counts.why_the_difference: earlier counts pooled the distinct values across both sides as raw categories; here the labels are per drug, so each side contributes its own level set
a_note_on_the_level_counts.does_not_affect_the_conclusion: both partitions use their own real level sets and their own size multisets

what_this_means_for_the_claim.the_mechanism_interpretation_survives: the prior works because the partition groups drugs that behave similarly, not because it happens to create well-populated bins
what_this_means_for_the_claim.what_it_does_not_address: why those particular groups behave similarly, which remains a descriptive statement rather than a mechanism
what_this_means_for_the_claim.consequence: C108's conclusion is now supported by a stricter null than the one it was originally tested against
